planets.name: TOI-6383 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6383 A with a 1.79-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-6383 A b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6383 A. Its orbit and size follow Bernabò et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
